goal: Develop and benchmark the pouring phase in MuJoCo, then transfer the controller to the Quanta X1 using observations from the physical setup.

handoff.start: The base is parked at a specified pose, the robot holds an open upright bottle with a known water volume, and the empty cylinder is within reach.
handoff.end: The bottle is upright at the specified retract pose, the grasp is retained, and all water in flight has landed.

responsibilities: Water discharge, flight, collection, spill, and changing load
Observations compatible with estimates from physical sensors
checkpoint: Reset to the same starting state on each run.
Verify water volume balance and register spill on a deliberate miss.
Validate a free grasp during lift and tilt, and compare flow and shutoff with physical pours.

responsibilities: Deterministic inverse kinematics and trajectory timing
Retargeting from measured state during execution

outputs: Execution status such as accepted, reached, or failed

checkpoint: Execute raise, aim, tilt, return upright, and retract within agreed tracking tolerances.
Demonstrate that an upright request can interrupt an active tilt.

scoring.signed_volume_error: Collected volume minus requested volume after the water settles.
scoring.spill: Water discharged from the bottle that ends outside the cylinder. The current parcel model scores total spill. Impact splash requires a separate model or physical measurement.
scoring.completion: Require an upright bottle at the retract pose, a retained grasp, and no disallowed contact.

checkpoint: Distinguish a successful nominal pour, an underpour, and a deliberately misaligned pour.
Use the same reset, observations, motion layer, and scoring for both controllers.

outputs: Target bottle pose with optional timing

approaches.scripted: Use explicit phases and feedback to decide when to return upright. Account for water in flight and water discharged while righting the bottle.
approaches.learned: Choose targets through the same interface as the scripted controller.

checkpoint: Complete one closed-loop scripted pour in MuJoCo using the existing water and motion layers.
Compare both controllers under identical conditions.
Once both pass the fixed case, evaluate held-out variations in bottle pose, fill level, and sensor delay.

hardware_checks: Verify grasp retention during a slow tilt.
Confirm how collected volume and spill can be measured.
Measure actuator tracking and sensor error before assessing transfer.
open_decisions: Volume feedback and spill measurement on hardware
Timing constraints for an upright retarget
Allowed variation in the pickup and navigation handoff
